title: AI News Daily — August 27, 2026
summary: Nvidia posted a record $96.2 billion quarter, up 106% year-over-year, and guided to $108 billion next as AI infrastructure demand keeps outrunning supply. Meanwhile, Z.ai revealed its viral mystery model Ox Alpha was GLM-5.3-Flash, served entirely on Chinese chips. And Anthropic signed a $45 billion compute deal with UK infrastructure startup Nscale.
